plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Major streaming reliability fix: add --http-chunk-size 1M to subprocess yt-dlp to fix CDN stalling on ARM Linux. When ffmpeg direct URL fails, fallback now reuses already-resolved CDN URL instead of re-extracting from YouTube (reduces fallback latency from ~27s to ~15s). Fix persistent YDL node provider patch applied before instance creation.
plugin.creator: schmij97
